body:
[A10] Recorded from the review rounds of #413 (PR #428, rounds R85-4 and R86-5), which measured it and judged it out of that lane's scope. Both directions below are pre-existing: they answer identically at the base of that lane and at all five of its heads.

## What the walk does today

`scripts/gen_toc.py` classifies blocks with a flat line walk: containers (list items, block quotes, footnote definitions) do not open a scope of their own. Two consequences were measured against GitHub's renderer.

1. Escape direction. After a blank line inside a list item, a plain line indented into the item's content column (two or three spaces) is read as a fresh top-level paragraph, while the renderer holds it inside the item. A lone inline or unknown tag on the next line therefore interrupts nothing for the renderer, which opens an HTML block and reads a heading inside it as text, while the walk keeps the heading. A Contents label mirrored from that heading obtains the em-dash exemption of CONTRIBUTING.md 6.1 while pointing at an anchor the page does not have. Eleven shapes were measured on this family; one space of indentation and four both agree with the renderer, as do the block quote, the footnote definition and the tab, so the family is narrow and its boundary is the item's content column, not a blanket indentation rule.

2. Withholding direction. `HEAD_RE` is ATX-only and the walk is flat, so a setext heading, a heading inside a block quote and a heading indented into a list item are never listed at all. The generator omits the section and refuses a label copied from it, which a contributor sees immediately.

## Why it is not fixed in #413's lane

#413 froze on the type-7 HTML block exemption, and its five rounds closed every shape inside that scope. Distinguishing a container's own paragraph from a top-level one is a change to the walk's state model, not a rule fix: the test is the item's content column, and the walk's own docstring records flatness as a deliberate property ("both withhold, neither invents"), which this issue shows is true in one direction and not the other. The module also sits three lines under its long-module ratchet, so the change needs room the lane does not have.

## Objective

The walk distinguishes a container's own paragraph from a top-level paragraph by the container's content column, and lists the headings a reader sees inside containers, or the limitation is stated in the walk's docstring and in CONTRIBUTING.md 6.1 with its direction and its boundary.

## Acceptance and validation

1. The eleven measured shapes of family one agree with GitHub's renderer, and the shapes that already agree (one space, four spaces, the block quote, the footnote definition, the tab) still agree.
2. The five shapes of family two are either listed with the anchors the renderer gives them, or named in the limitation with their direction.
3. Each new property carries an arm that fails when the property is removed, in the style of the existing corpus.
4. The per-page classification of every tracked page is unchanged except where family two adds a heading, and that difference is enumerated.
5. `gen_toc.py --selftest`, `--check`, `--verify-anchors`, `check_em_dash.py --selftest` and the documentation gates pass; no ratchet is widened.

## Authority and scope

CommonMark 0.31 sections 4.2 to 4.4 and 5.2 to 5.3; the GFM extension for footnote definitions; CONTRIBUTING.md 6.1; docs/development/CODE_QUALITY.md rule 12. Out of scope: the exemption rule itself, the provenance basis, and the type-1 and types 3 to 5 residues already declared on #413.

Lane and review: unassigned; assigned when the lane opens. Not on the October critical path.

[A10] IMPLEMENTATION CHOICE / READY TAKEOVER

#507 has merged as 88e9276b2a220c716f64a843f7e1eb8f9265e896; its current-branch containment, merged-PR sweep and review-integrity audits pass. The shared Markdown parser author slot is now free.

Choose the bounded implementation path permitted by #437: repair family one's escaping classification by tracking the list item's content column and its paragraph context, and retain family two's existing withholding with explicit, direction-specific limitations in the walk's docstring and CONTRIBUTING.md section 6.1. Setext headings and the five measured container-heading shapes remain omitted; this task does not add their anchors. This selects the documented-limitation alternative of acceptance 2, without relaxing acceptance 1 or the exemption/provenance rules.

Reproduce the eleven reported escape shapes against GitHub's renderer and retain the one-space, four-space, quote, footnote and tab boundaries. Add failure-sensitive controls for each new property. With no family-two heading addition selected, acceptance 4 requires identical per-page classifications across the tracked corpus; any discovered conflict with that criterion must be published before changing scope. Keep all landed #507 closer controls and all earlier corpus arms, without widening ratchets. Extract a coherent helper if needed for size limits; no unrelated parser rewrite.

Executor A168 (Codex); independent cleared-context internal reviewer R237 (Codex) and external reviewer R238 (Opus); manager A10. Branch437-container-paragraph-scopes will be created from current dev using gh issue develop. Move to In progress before the author edits. This is the only active implementation author. #464, #478 and PP #101 are frozen validation/review lanes; shared builder/CI authors remain serialized separately.

[A168] TAKEN

Branch: `437-container-paragraph-scopes`, clean starting head `88e9276b2a220c716f64a843f7e1eb8f9265e896` (tree `c23dff6c0eafdf5ae89bb3e8a9416c55533a2332`). Manager A10; reserved independent cold reviewers R237 internal Codex / R238 external Opus. Project already In progress; branch created through `gh issue develop` by the manager.

Authoritative references: #437 and [selected implementation decision](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/437#issuecomment-5775771538); CONTRIBUTING 5/6.1; CODE_QUALITY rule 12; [CommonMark 0.31.2 sections 4.2-4.4 and 5.2-5.3](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/), with 4.6 for type-7 paragraph interruption and GitHub GFM rendering for footnotes. Original public measurements: [R85-4](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/428#issuecomment-5644713074) and [R86-5](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/pull/428#issuecomment-5644834363).

Interpreted scope: repair family one's paragraph context at the list item's content column, preserving one-space/four-space/quote/footnote/tab agreements. Keep family two withheld and document its five measured forms and direction in the walk docstring and CONTRIBUTING 6.1. Add no container/setext headings and change no provenance or exemption policy. AC4 therefore requires identical classifications over every tracked Markdown page. Preserve every existing corpus arm and #507 closer control without widening ratchets. No product, RTL, dependency, workflow, optional neighboring change, or other lane work.

Validation plan: capture base/head blocks, headings/anchors and generated navigation on identical tracked-page inputs; fresh synthetic `gh api markdown` GFM fixtures, preserving exact requests/results; `python3 -B scripts/gen_toc.py --selftest`, `--check`, `--verify-anchors`; `python3 -B scripts/check_em_dash.py --selftest` and `--base 88e9276b2a220c716f64a843f7e1eb8f9265e896`; focused documentation, idiom, ratchet and integration gates; independent negative/reversion controls and refusal checks. Record actual execution head/tree and command exits. Manager owns full native, act, hosted, candidate and post-merge bars; no push/PR operations from this author.

Evidence boundary: the public R86-5 text names eleven escape row IDs but its original shapes JSON/HTML files have local-only references. Fresh fixtures will be identified as reconstructions from the published descriptions, with their exact text and measured results published; archival byte identity will not be claimed without the original public artifacts.

Blockers: none to starting bounded implementation; any actual corpus or normative conflict will be published before dependent edits continue.

title: The Contents walk reads containers flat, so a container's own paragraph and headings inside containers are misclassified
